arithmetic_proof: For admitted positive calls, count numerator is at most 4032*44100+37800-1=177848999, and output position at most 9407*37800=355584600. Signed16 delta is within +/-65535, product is evaluated in int64 then converted to uint32 modulo 2^32. Unsigned bits are mapped into int64 signed32 range by subtraction, so division is defined. Final low16 bits are mapped into int16 range before conversion. Index bounds follow duration ceiling and capacity cap.
